name: headless-app-tanstack
title: Headless App for TanStack Start
description: A TanStack Start app for an agent-first product: auth, OAuth consent, an MCP server, and a page to manage connected agents.
docs: This block installs the [Password-Based Auth](https://supabase.com/library/docs/tanstack/password-based-auth), [OAuth Consent](https://supabase.com/library/docs/tanstack/oauth-consent), and [MCP Server](https://supabase.com/library/docs/headless/mcp-server) blocks, then adds `/agents` on top of them. It also writes `supabase/config.toml`, which overwrites an existing file — merge your own settings back in after installing. Set the Auth Site URL to the origin that serves `/oauth/consent`, run `supabase config push` and `supabase functions deploy mcp-server`, then sign in and open `/agents`.
